Thanks for the attachments, Alex — good to have these. A couple of procurement/legal items to flag before we accept into production:

1) COI: the certificate shows required limits but there is no endorsement naming Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured. We require the endorsement for third-party integrations handling production data. Please request the Additional Insured endorsement and a Waiver of Subrogation on the General Liability policy.

2) Subprocessors: the spreadsheet looks fine but we need a short attestation that no subcontractors will handle regulated customer data (PII/PHI) without prior notification.

3) SOC2: the summary is acceptable for now; we may request the auditor contact if we see gaps during security review.

Procurement note: we can provision a conditional PO that will allow testing access and initial onboarding activities for up to 14 days while the endorsement is processed, but finance will only release invoices against the PO once the endorsement is confirmed. Ben — please confirm you want us to issue a conditional PO.

Connor / Mina — looping you for legal/finance signoff on the conditional PO wording (term length, invoicing hold).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Alex Hart <alex.hart@edgesense.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: vendor onboarding evidence and PO contact

Kimberly — yes please go ahead with the conditional PO. EdgeSense needs sandbox access and the ability to run initial integration tests next week. Proposed conditioning:

- Conditional PO valid for 14 calendar days from issuance (until 2026-01-29)
- Invoicing hold: finance will queue invoices but payment contingent on receipt of Additional Insured endorsement and Waiver of Subrogation
- If endorsement not received by expiry, PO will be canceled and any services will be billed as pre-contract at vendor's discretion

Alex — does EdgeSense accept a 14-day conditional PO window while you obtain the endorsement? If so, we'll have finance issue PO-REDWOOD-1184 with the above conditions.

Thanks — Ben
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
